shortDescription: India likely grew at more than 7% last quarter, a pace most major economies would envy, according to Bloomberg.Even so, that pace may still be too slow to fulfill Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s goal of making India a developed nation.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Modi’s Developed-Nation Goal Faces India’s Growth Gap
